text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Summer camp season has come around again!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Hey, Dia. Do you have a second?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: What's up?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Well… Do you remember what I said at the Takarazuka Kinen?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: About how everyone is expecting great things from me?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes, of course.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Well, I was thinking about the kind of expectations they might have.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: And… I've made up my mind!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: If people see themselves in me, then I'm going to keep running without giving up!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I'm sure they all believe that I can rise from rock bottom and claw my way back up to the top!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: My pluck, refusal to ever give up, and tenacity to stick through things until the very end is what makes me me, after all!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hehe! That's exactly who you are!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Which is why I'm aiming for a clean sweep in the autumn Tenno Sho, Japan Cup, and Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I'm going to beat both Teio and McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I know just how strong they are since I've looked up to them since forever. I know just how difficult it's gonna be…

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: But that's exactly why I want to beat them! I want to rise higher than the people I look up to!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I have to surpass my idols in order to make up for letting everyone down at the Takarazuka Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: My goal is the same as yours. I'm aiming to outshine those I admire too.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: And I won't lose to you either!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Good! Let's both give it our all! Anyway, I'll see you later!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hehe… Good for you, Kita!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Oh, by the way, Trainer, I have something to discuss with you.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: It's in regards to our future plans. You see, I was hoping to work on increasing my strength so I'm able to handle myself in a variety of situations.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I went to watch one of McQueen's races the other day for research purposes.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Her legs are strong enough to deal with even soft ground conditions. The power of her strides left a significant impression on me.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I believe having such power would make it easier for me to break away from the pack in my races.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Or rather, I realized that if I want to stand a chance against McQueen and Teio, I need to gain the strength I'm currently lacking.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I don't want to squander the opportunity they offered me. I want to face their challenge in peak condition and win!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Of course, this is also in preparation for the future, as I'd like to be an illustrious runner competing overseas someday!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I remember how the possibility of her running on the international stage was raised back at the New Year's party.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She'll certainly need strength to run on the difficult tracks she'll face abroad.
choice_data_list: Why do you want to run internationally?
Why do you want to run internationally?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I haven't decided for sure yet, but… Do you remember that we spoke about what my running could give to people the other day?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: You mentioned you saw the power of possibility in me, and that made me realize something.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: The Japanese Umamusume community has constantly been thwarted at France's traditional and prestigious races…

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: But as the one who managed to break the Satono family's jinx, if I win one of those races, I believe I can show people how it's always possible to make history.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: And to do that, I thought it prudent to set my sights on the international stage early.
choice_data_list: I see. Let's do it, then.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just as she says, the stronger she becomes, the more adaptable she'll be in different scenarios. I see no reason to refuse her request.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Sorry to make things so difficult, but thank you for agreeing to help me.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I must master a powerful new running style… I must!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: If I can't do that, I'll never be able to beat McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With a battle against her idol on the horizon and a clear vision for her next goal, Satono Diamond is absolutely brimming with enthusiasm.
